payload.content: To extract a year, month, or day component from a date column in SQLite, use `STRFTIME('%Y', date_col)`, `STRFTIME('%m', date_col)`, or `STRFTIME('%d', date_col)`. The functions `YEAR()`, `MONTH()`, `DAY()`, and `EXTRACT()` are NOT supported in SQLite and will raise an error.

rationale: gepa_decompose: replaces unsupported YEAR()/MONTH() with STRFTIME idiom; single-flip Δ measures whether the substitution lands.
